exercise.staffing_review: The CHRO keeps every post and reporting line in the examined branch for the trial. Agents prepare policy answers, but the HR Service Coordinator still resolves unclear or conflicting answers and supervises the agents, so no post is removed. Post counts across the 480-person function and in the other regional HR teams were not examined.
